Unlisted or unchanged fields keep the model's current assumption — nothing breaks if you leave a field alone. This file is yours: regenerating overrides.template.json never overwrites it. Add any other input here too — 'global' patches by driver name (see model_inputs.json), 'assets.<asset>' patches by input key.
